From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Post-call recap + proposed POC success criteria and owners

Hi Tom / Sarah -

Thanks again for a productive demo earlier today. Quick recap and the proposed plan for the 4-week POC so we can get approval on timelines and owners from your side. Please let me know any changes.

Summary of objectives
- Validate integration of Clearlake's patient-notes ingestion flow with Redwood's hosted inference (throughput and latency targets)
- Measure quality on the clinical extraction prompts (target: >= 92% entity recall on our sample set)
- Confirm infra & security fit for production (network, KMS, audit logs)

Proposed success criteria (attached: Clearlake_POC_success_criteria.docx):
1) Latency: p95 inference latency < 450ms for 512-token baseline (50k requests/day simulated)
2) Throughput: sustain 120 rps during batch window without errors
3) Accuracy: extraction F1 >= 0.88 on the evaluation prompt set
4) Security: SOC 2 evidence and allowed network flow documented and accepted

High-level evaluation plan
- Week 0: Credentials, test dataset exchange, and infra access (1-2 days)
- Week 1: Integration + baseline runs (3 days)
- Week 2: Load testing and tuning (2 days)
- Week 3: Quality validation and regression checks (3 days)
- Week 4: Consolidate results and review (1 day)

RACI / ownership (please confirm):
- App integration (API & SDK): Clearlake app team (owner: Tom) / Redwood SE (R: lauren_bishop)
- Infra & Networking (VPC, routing): Clearlake infra (owner: Daniel Ruiz) / Redwood infra docs + support (A: lauren_bishop)
- Security & Compliance (SOC2, logs): Clearlake security (consult: Sarah) / Redwood security (owner: laura_bennett)
- Procurement / SOW: Clearlake procurement (owner: Daniel) / Redwood sales (owner: marissa_cole)

Next steps I need from Clearlake by EOD Fri:
- Confirm owners for Infra / Procurement (first names + emails)
- Share a non-sensitive sample dataset (S3 link or secure upload)
- Any network allowlist requirements

Attachments: Clearlake_POC_success_criteria.docx, Clearlake_ROI_template.xlsx

Thanks - happy to jump on a quick call if it helps finalize owners.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: SOC2 summary + network options for Clearlake POC

Hi Tom / Marissa -

Attaching a short SOC2_summary.pdf (redwood redacted summary) and a one-pager on networking options for POCs. Quick answers to Tom's questions:
- Baseline latency tests: we can run against your on-prem staging via our Private deployment (VPC) or we can allowlist our hosted IPs for the Hosted API approach. Both are feasible; the Private option gives better network isolation and realistic latency.
- Connectivity: VPN is not required. Most customers use allowlisted IPs or a VPC peering connection. For Vault/KMS, we support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own KMS) and can document the flow.

I've attached SOC2_summary.pdf and Network_Options_POC.pdf. If you prefer, I can schedule a 30-min sync with your infra and security folks next week.

Action items from Redwood: 
- Laura: provide SOC2 summary + network one-pager (done, attached)
- Lauren: schedule a 30-min infra sync once Clearlake confirms Daniel's availability
- Marissa: finalize SOW template / ROI worksheet and share
